evidenceSemantics.observedOutcome: A concrete check ran and emitted a pass or failure observation for one exact subject. A later failure does not erase an earlier observation.
evidenceSemantics.acceptedEvidence: A receipt was validated against its exact candidate, tree, deployment, and authority rules. Accepted stage evidence is monotone within an evidence bundle.
evidenceSemantics.overallAcceptance: The bundle is accepted only when every required stage, five distinct assurance principals, evidence-before-approval chronology, and the final production approval are accepted. A failed bundle may retain earlier accepted stage evidence without authorizing production or release.

operations.semantics: Projects bounded coherent session/snapshot and principal-scoped pending/terminal facts without issuing authority.
Exclusively reserves and durably records a confirmed exact operation before one authenticated transport request; backend admission remains authoritative.
The typed Method::Stop path requires stop permission and RequestStop semantics; acknowledgement remains pending until authenticated terminal observation.

invariants: Rust presentation owns no runtime state, admission authority or terminal facts.
The existing native gateway remains read-only; native observations are never relabeled as a ui.control mutation session.
Explicit session, transport endpoint, protocol and principal bind the recovery scope before import or dispatch.
Exclusive mutable ownership serializes session and operation transitions; bounded identity reservation precedes persistence and possible dispatch.
Response loss and V1 missing lookup remain indeterminate; unresolved identities never replay automatically.
Canonical JSON and existing digest domains retain strict input bounds, NFC/safe integers, duplicate rejection and exact identity binding.
Expiry, permission revision changes, stale snapshots and changed confirmations fail closed before new requests.
Durable terminal cleanup requires exact original admission bytes and matching authenticated audit identity; failed maintenance retains facts.
Legacy JavaScript source and workflows exist only inside a hash-bound regression oracle archive, never active product packages.
Runtime, deployment, acceptance, activation and release flags remain false without separately observed exact-source evidence.

verification.accessibility: Native egui/AccessKit rendering in ui.native; physical screen-reader/IME/DPI acceptance unobserved; no active browser distribution
